rdfs:label: Alarm
rdfs:comment: A clock alarm — a recurring wake or reminder trigger at a wall-clock time, typically modelled as a recurring iCalendar event carrying an embedded VALARM.
notes: Not ical:Valarm — that is the RFC 5545 alarm *subcomponent* (action + trigger) attached to an event or to-do, while urn:solid:Alarm is the standalone clock alarm itself. No upstream vocabulary has a standalone clock-alarm class (VALARM only exists inside another component), so this term names one. Intended usage is dual-typing: '@type': ['Vevent', 'urn:solid:Alarm'] on a daily-recurring event with floating-time dtstart (RFC 5545 floating time = rings at the same wall-clock time in any timezone), rrule FREQ=DAILY (or BYDAY for weekday schedules), status CONFIRMED/CANCELLED for enabled/disabled, and an embedded Valarm marking it as one that rings. First user: the solid-apps alarm app.

examples.title: A daily wake-up alarm (dual-typed recurring Vevent)

history.note: Initial term, proposed alongside the alarm app's iCal data model (solid-apps/alarm#7).
